first.rationale: Prioritize verification of onboarding simplification and promotional pricing because they are the most consequential competing responses to the current activation/onboarding decline and price-sensitive SMB loss. Current intent is to simplify onboarding: two inherited records indicate durable self-serve activation and time-to-value gains, while discounting may win acquisition at potential long-term qualification, margin, and retention cost. The experiment should measure qualified-revenue and retention proxies, not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding for self-serve SMB accounts. Verified evidence shows shortened onboarding increased completion 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and improved 30-day retention 3%; the independent signup-simplification result further supports an activation benefit. This directly addresses the 4% onboarding-completion decline and 6% activation decline while supporting durable qualified revenue. Do not use targeted promotional pricing: although it lifted qualified revenue short term, verified 30-day retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive its first renewal cycle. Evaluate the onboarding test on qualified activation, time-to-value, conversion to qualified revenue, and retention/renewal proxies rather than completion alone.
